summary: Lets a profile build its own Telegram bot menu from the functions of its apps.

features.title: Custom menu bot
features.short: Your own buttons, your own answers
features.description: Build a Telegram bot with a menu of your own. Add a button, give it a name, choose an app and one of the functions that app offers, and decide how each value is obtained: the bot can ask for it in the chat, offer the app's own choices as buttons, or always use a value you fix. Then write the answer the bot sends back and place values in it, for example “In {category_id} there is now {balance}”. A button can add an amount to a Budget category, show a list, or run any other function an app offers through its App API on your behalf. The administrator switches custom bots on in the Telegram Hub settings, and the App API of each app must be enabled in Apps Hub.
